description: Change edge/street coloring to display traffic density in sumo-gui using the Bologna Pasubio scenario. The sumo-gui application is already open with the Bologna Pasubio real-world road network loaded (from the Pasubio area in Bologna, Italy). The simulation is loaded but not yet started. Your task is to: 1. Open the Edit Visualization dialog by pressing F9 (or go to Edit > Edit Visualization). 2. In the dialog, click the 'Streets' tab on the left sidebar (this controls how road edges are colored). 3. Under the edge/lane coloring dropdown, change the coloring scheme from 'uniform' to 'by current occupancy (lanewise, brutto)' (you may need to scroll down in the dropdown to find it). 4. Click 'OK' to apply the changes and close the dialog. 5. Start the simulation by pressing Ctrl+A. The road segments should now be color-coded based on how many vehicles are currently on them (busy roads in warmer colors). 6. Take a screenshot of the visualization using the system screenshot tool: open a terminal and run 'scrot /home/ga/SUMO_Output/occupancy_coloring.png'.
